title: अंश ४ · अध्याय १७

items.text: आरब्धस्यात्मजो गान्धारः गान्धारस्य धर्मः धर्मात्घृतः घृतात्दुर्दमः ततः प्रचेताः ॥ ४,१७.४ ॥
items.tr: ārabdhasyātmajo gāndhāraḥ gāndhārasya dharmaḥ dharmātghṛtaḥ ghṛtātdurdamaḥ tataḥ pracetāḥ || 4,17.4 ||

en_chapter: The son of Druhya was Babhru, whose son was Setu, whose son was Aradwat, whose son was Gandhara, whose son was Dharma, whose son was Dhrita, whose son was Duryaman, whose son was Prachetas, who had a hundred sons and they were the princes of the lawless Mlechehhas or barbarians of the north.
